summary: Organigram Global filed a 6-K attaching an October 15, 2026 news release updating the accelerated integration of Germany's Sanity Group and a unified global operating model, mapped in US terms to an operational restructuring disclosure rather than a transaction. Management expects $8M-$10M annualized run-rate savings ($4.5M-$5.5M SG&A; $3.5M-$4.5M operating), $5M-$6M realized in Fiscal 2027, full benefit in Fiscal 2028, with $2M one-time costs. Three brands are discontinued and SKUs trimmed, concentrating investment on SHRED, BOXHOT and Big Bag O Buds. No board recommendation, advisor, price or closing terms disclosed; watch execution risk, savings timing and margin delivery.
